title: Free Southern Theater, donated instruments, fundraising and the opening
summary: John O'Neal and the Free Southern Theater gave funding advice, instruments were collected for poor kids, a fundraising party and the fire code work followed, and the Workshop opened and then slid into debt as Dizzy hired George and David.
